persona.name: Sleek Minimalist

looks: A dark navy cashmere crewneck sweater tucked into charcoal wide-leg trousers with sleek straight hair and silver hoop earrings.
A deep teal silk blouse paired with a black A-line midi skirt, side-parted waves, and a silver link watch.
A dark burgundy turtleneck under a black tailored blazer with dark navy straight-leg jeans, a low ponytail, and silver stud earrings.
persona.formula: Dark neutral base + one deep jewel tone + polished silver jewelry
